answer: Require each new agent identity to lock a slowly vesting stake that is slashed if peers catch it double-voting. Like a coral reef, honest reputation accretes over many epochs, while a sybil swarm is a shifting dune: a thousand fake accounts each need their own locked deposit, so the attacker pays stake times count and risks losing all of it. Even a whisper of correlated behavior across those wallets triggers a slashing review.
